description: Open-license stand-in corpus for M0-OWNER-01 (10 rooms + 5 tabletops) sourced from free online videos by Owner decision (2026-09-28) instead of Owner-shot iPhone scans. Media lives only in the private gj-corpus Modal volume under /open-video; never in git.
revision_note: Round 2 (Owner follow-up): replaced short, portrait, barely-moving or shallow-depth-of-field clips with longer, higher-coverage walkthroughs and orbits (room tours, museum walks, FPV fly-throughs, diorama orbits). 2 round-1 clips kept, 13 new. Superseded round-1 clips were moved (not deleted) to /open-video/_superseded/. Each clip lists segments (hard-cut detection), recommended_segments (visually reviewed usable ranges, clip and source times), usable_duration_s and a coverage note.
